questions.question: Describe agglomerative clustering.
questions.solution_html:
• Agglomerative clustering is a hierarchical clustering method in which each data point starts as a
  • separate cluster, and clusters are progressively merged based on similarity until a single cluster
  • or the desired number of clusters is obtained.
  • Mutations Affect Function
  • Changes in amino acid sequence can alter folding and biological activity.
  • Security Monitoring
  • Detect suspicious activities and unauthorized access attempts.
  • Comparative Genomics
  • Allows comparison of pathways across different organisms.
  • Identification of Co-expressed Genes
  • Genes with similar expression patterns are grouped together.
  • Feature Values are Independent Within Classes
  • Feature values are assumed independent when the class is known.
  • Advantages
  • Simple, fast, and effective for large datasets and text classification.
